tenants.title: Platform console
tenants.subtitle: Every school on this deployment, its health and its active modules.
tenants.emptyBody: Schools you create will show up here.

suspendDialog.title: Suspend this school?
suspendDialog.body: {name} will be suspended and its {count} users cannot sign in until you resume it.

create.title: Add school
create.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. sman-1-denpasar. Filled in from the name.
create.name: School name
create.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
create.adminSectionHint: Created with the school. Its password is shown once after the school is created.

created.title: School created
created.body: Give these credentials to the school's administrator now. Once this dialog closes the password cannot be seen again.
created.onceTitle: The password is shown only once
created.copyFailed: Could not copy. Copy it by hand.

detail.title: School detail
detail.exportBody: Builds a ZIP with this school's core data (users, academic years, classes) as CSV.
detail.flagsHint: A module switched off disappears from the menu of every user of this school. Changes apply at once.
detail.domainHint: The address the school opens the app on. Leave empty to use the default address.

operatorAlerts.title: Operator alerts
operatorAlerts.subtitle: Telegram reminders for server health checks, set up without editing files on the server.
operatorAlerts.loadError: Could not load operator alert settings.

botSetup.title: Create a Telegram bot
botSetup.step1: Open Telegram, search for @BotFather, and send the /newbot command.
botSetup.step2: Follow its prompts to name the bot and get an access token.
botSetup.step3: Paste that token into the field below, then save.

token.label: Telegram bot token
token.removed: The token will be removed once you save

detect.empty: No chats found yet. Send any message to the bot on Telegram, then try again.
detect.error: Could not detect chats. Check the bot token.

chatId.label: Telegram chat id
chatId.hint: Send any message to the bot, then use Detect chat to fill this in.

test.failure: Could not send the test message
test.needChat: Enter a chat id or use Detect chat first.

thresholds.title: Thresholds
thresholds.description: A reminder goes out when a value crosses these limits.

dailySummary.title: Daily summary
dailySummary.enabledHint: One message with the result of every check each day.
dailySummary.hourHint: In WITA, the operator server's time.

operatorAlerts.enabledHint: Switch off to stop every reminder without losing the settings.
